description: Plan your next group event smarter. With Cvent, you can discover over 340,000 properties worldwide. Whether you're planning for a corporate meeting or a large conference, a wedding or promotional social event, there's a venue that's perfect for you. Easily search by location, event dates, expected attendee count, and desired amenities. Compare venues side-by-side, and when you've found the right one, go to Cvent.com to access detailed information and to submit your RFPs.
